_meta.purpose: Maintained jurisdiction-risk list for the FATF R.10 risk-based approach. Used ONLY to nudge a deterministic risk score (decision-support); it never decides. Missing/empty => no jurisdiction bump.
_meta.source_of_truth: FATF public statements — 'Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring' (grey) and 'High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action' (high/black).
_meta.maintenance: REVIEW AND UPDATE after every FATF plenary (Feb / Jun / Oct). Remove de-listed jurisdictions; add new ones. This file is a maintained control, not authoritative legal advice — verify against the latest FATF statement before relying on it.
_meta.note: Customer-base home jurisdictions (UAE, Turkey) were de-listed by FATF in 2024 and are deliberately NOT included here, to avoid false jurisdiction flags.
